findings.description: 30-node real evidence exists, but committed artifacts lack a timing breakdown path and no p13_timing_breakdown_scale_30.json exists. L07 must not infer process startup, cluster meet/create, slot assignment, or convergence timings from wrapper wall time or reports.
evidence: L07 acceptance requires 30/50/100 scale build metrics

findings.description: Current coverage marks cluster_build as SKIPPED_WITH_REASON for 30, 50, and 100 even though some 50/100 timing data is present under the scale surface. L07 can falsely pass if it only checks scale coverage instead of cluster-build metric completeness.

Resource exhaustion is a real acceptance blocker for 30/50/100 reruns. Preflight checks are necessary but not sufficient because the memory check is a host-visible estimate; any failed preflight, unavailable ports, Docker unavailability, cleanup leftovers, timeout, or partial artifact must produce BLOCKED/FAIL, never PASS.
evidence: src/valkey_scale_lab/resource.py memory_budget uses a conservative host-visible estimate
AGENTS.md requires deterministic cleanup and collision checks
codex/loop_engineering/04_STAGE_MANIFEST.md says resource insufficiency cannot be PASS

findings.description: P14 dry-run artifacts can be accidentally counted as real scale coverage or used to fill 1000+ cluster-build cells. L07 must keep P14 out of real evidence and must not run P14 without current-session opt-in and the required environment value.

evidence: codex/loop_engineering/03_HARNESS_POLICY.md blocks modifying historical artifacts to make results look passing

findings.description: Harness weakening is the easiest way to fake L07 success. The stage must block lowered min node counts, removed required artifacts, relaxed schemas, deleted tests, hand-written PASS gate results, or converting missing metrics to skipped without a reason.

proposed_harness.name: scale_build_metrics_schema
proposed_harness.acceptance: Define a machine-readable scale build metrics artifact requiring per-rung node_count, source_artifact sha256, resource_preflight status, startup timing, meet/create timing, slot assignment timing, role convergence, membership convergence, SET/GET data-path proof, cleanup timing, residual scan, and explicit missing semantics.

proposed_harness.name: audit_scale_build_metrics_30_50_100
proposed_harness.acceptance: Audit 30, 50, and 100 layers from committed artifacts and fail if any required metric is absent without MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, or NO_BASELINE_YET and a reason.

proposed_harness.name: cluster_build_coverage_matrix_gate
proposed_harness.acceptance: Require coverage_matrix cluster_build entries for 30, 50, and 100 to be COVERED or explicitly BLOCKED/MISSING in the L07 audit artifact; scale surface coverage alone is insufficient.

proposed_harness.name: p14_dryrun_boundary_regression
proposed_harness.acceptance: Continue verifying no P14 real evidence exists, no L07 command log contains P14 execution or VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN, and 1000-dry-run never has real_valkey_coverage=true.

proposed_harness.name: report_source_of_truth_guard
proposed_harness.acceptance: Reject any L07 metric whose source_artifact suffix is .html, .svg, .csv, or .md unless the metric is explicitly evidence_class=report_view and not measured.

proposed_harness.name: resource_blocked_not_pass_fixture
proposed_harness.acceptance: Inject failed resource_preflight checks and assert the L07 audit reports BLOCKED/FAIL with the failed check and reason, never PASS.

proposed_harness.name: anti_regression_scale_harness_diff
proposed_harness.acceptance: Scan diffs to block lowered min-nodes, weakened real_valkey_required, removed timing fields, schema enum relaxation, deleted scale tests, and manually edited gate PASS results.

implementation_plan.step: Model L07 scale build metrics as an artifact-first audit rather than as a report renderer change.
implementation_plan.rationale: The current report layer already renders views; L07 needs a source-of-truth audit artifact that distinguishes measured values from historical gaps.

implementation_plan.step: Normalize 30/50/100 rung observations with explicit statuses for every required build metric.
implementation_plan.rationale: 30 lacks timing artifacts today; the correct behavior is explicit MISSING/SKIPPED_WITH_REASON until real wrapper-produced evidence exists.

implementation_plan.step: Extend metric coverage only from machine-readable L07 and scale artifacts.
implementation_plan.rationale: Cluster-build coverage must not remain hidden under the scale surface or be sourced from visualization files.

implementation_plan.step: Keep P14 and host-network protections in CI and command-log checks.
implementation_plan.rationale: The biggest safety regressions are accidental P14 execution and host-level network mutations.

implementation_plan.step: Regenerate reports only after the L07 machine-readable artifact passes schema validation.
implementation_plan.rationale: Visualizations should display scale ladder and timing breakdowns without becoming source-of-truth.

acceptance_criteria: 30, 50, and 100 each have an L07 scale-build metrics/audit record with schema-valid source paths, sha256s, status, node_count, run_id or explicit missing reason.
The 30-node timing gap is either filled by wrapper-produced real evidence or encoded as MISSING/SKIPPED_WITH_REASON with a reason; it is never reported as measured.

50 and 100 timing records include process/container startup, cluster meet/create, slot assignment, role convergence, membership convergence, data-path probe, cleanup timing, and residual scan or explicit missing semantics.
Any resource preflight FAIL, timeout, port collision, Docker unavailability, cleanup leftover, or partial artifact results in BLOCKED/FAIL and names the failed check.
1000+ remains dry-run/resource/planner only and has real_valkey_coverage=false in all L07 and coverage artifacts.
Rendered HTML, SVG, CSV, and markdown files are never measured metric sources.
Safety scan and anti-regression checks block host-network mutation, sudo network commands, lowered node requirements, relaxed schemas, deleted assertions, or hand-written gate PASS results.
Reports and visualizations show scale ladder and timing breakdown data only after the underlying JSON artifacts pass schema validation.
risks: Resource exhaustion during real 30/50/100 gates can leave partial artifacts or leftovers; failed preflight or cleanup must block acceptance.
Committed real evidence can become stale relative to current code; L07 must preserve source hashes, command provenance, and historical drift findings.
P14 dry-run planner data can be accidentally counted as real scale evidence; every 1000+ metric must remain dry_run_only and non-real.
Historical timing gaps, especially 30-node timing, can be hidden by wrapper wall time or report values; missing metrics must remain explicit.
Report-layer fabrication can occur if SVG/HTML/CSV values are parsed back into metrics.
Host-network safety can be weakened by using sudo, firewall/routing tools, or broad process cleanup to make scale runs pass.
Harness weakening can appear as lower min-node thresholds, optional required fields, relaxed schemas, deleted tests, or manual PASS edits.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not run P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN or set VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN in this stage.
Do not run real Valkey scale gates as part of risk-auditor work.
Do not count scale_1000_dryrun_plan.json as real Valkey evidence.
Do not infer missing timing values from gate wall-clock durations, logs, SVGs, HTML, CSV, or markdown reports.
Do not edit historical gate_result.json or valkey_e2e_evidence JSON to make status PASS.
Do not lower min-nodes for 30/50/100 real evidence.
Do not weaken schemas, delete tests, make required fields optional, or convert failures to skips without reason.
Do not use sudo, PF, nftables, iptables, route, ifconfig, host interface mutation, or broad process kills.
notes: APPROVED for harness design because the required risks and blocker conditions are explicit. This approval does not approve current L07 completion: 30-node timing is a known gap, cluster_build coverage is currently skipped for 30/50/100, and any implementation that hides those gaps or uses P14/report-derived evidence must be blocked.
